recordings.name: q01-count-auth
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM authentication

recordings.name: q02-users
recordings.sql: SELECT user_name, count(*) AS n FROM authentication GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY user_name

recordings.name: q03-failures
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM authentication WHERE status_id = 2

recordings.name: q04-param-user
recordings.sql: SELECT uid FROM authentication WHERE user_name = :u ORDER BY uid LIMIT 5

recordings.name: q05-window
recordings.sql: SELECT uid FROM authentication WHERE time >= '2026-03-01 02:00:00' AND time < '2026-03-01 03:00:00' ORDER BY uid

recordings.name: q06-param-time
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM authentication WHERE time >= :t0

recordings.name: q07-min-max-time
recordings.sql: SELECT min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen FROM authentication

recordings.name: q08-by-activity
recordings.sql: SELECT activity_id, count(*) AS n FROM authentication GROUP BY activity_id ORDER BY activity_id

recordings.name: q09-mfa-bool
recordings.sql: SELECT is_mfa, count(*) AS n FROM authentication GROUP BY is_mfa ORDER BY is_mfa

recordings.name: q10-having
recordings.sql: SELECT user_name, count(*) AS n FROM authentication WHERE status_id = 2 GROUP BY user_name HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY n DESC, user_name

recordings.name: q11-protocols
recordings.sql: SELECT DISTINCT auth_protocol FROM authentication ORDER BY auth_protocol

recordings.name: q12-like
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM authentication WHERE message LIKE 'login f%'

recordings.name: q13-in
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM authentication WHERE user_name IN ('alice', 'bob')

recordings.name: q14-net-sums
recordings.sql: SELECT protocol_name, sum(bytes_in) AS bi, sum(bytes_out) AS bo FROM network_activity GROUP BY protocol_name ORDER BY protocol_name

recordings.name: q15-net-top
recordings.sql: SELECT uid, bytes_in FROM network_activity ORDER BY bytes_in DESC, uid LIMIT 5

recordings.name: q16-net-null-conn
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM network_activity WHERE connection_uid IS NULL

recordings.name: q17-net-avg
recordings.sql: SELECT round(avg(bytes_in), 2) AS avg_in FROM network_activity

recordings.name: q18-dns-top
recordings.sql: SELECT query_hostname, count(*) AS n FROM dns_activity GROUP BY query_hostname ORDER BY n DESC, query_hostname LIMIT 3

recordings.name: q19-dns-nx
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dns_activity WHERE rcode_id <> 0

recordings.name: q20-dns-types
recordings.sql: SELECT query_type, count(*) AS n FROM dns_activity GROUP BY query_type ORDER BY query_type

recordings.name: q21-det-by-id
recordings.sql: SELECT detection_id, count(*) AS n FROM detection_finding GROUP BY detection_id ORDER BY detection_id

recordings.name: q22-det-max-risk
recordings.sql: SELECT max(risk_score) AS top FROM detection_finding

recordings.name: q23-det-host-avg
recordings.sql: SELECT host_name, round(avg(risk_score), 1) AS avg_risk FROM detection_finding GROUP BY host_name ORDER BY host_name

recordings.name: q24-det-list-col
recordings.sql: SELECT uid, attack_techniques FROM detection_finding ORDER BY uid LIMIT 4

recordings.name: q25-vuln-high
recordings.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM vulnerability_finding WHERE cvss_score >= 7.0

recordings.name: q26-vuln-fixable
recordings.sql: SELECT fix_available, count(*) AS n FROM vulnerability_finding GROUP BY fix_available ORDER BY fix_available

recordings.name: q27-vuln-distinct-cve
recordings.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT cve_uid) AS n FROM vulnerability_finding

recordings.name: q28-vuln-pkg-avg
recordings.sql: SELECT package_name, round(avg(cvss_score), 2) AS avg_cvss FROM vulnerability_finding GROUP BY package_name ORDER BY package_name

recordings.name: q29-join-host
recordings.sql: SELECT d.host_name, count(*) AS pairs FROM detection_finding d JOIN vulnerability_finding v ON d.host_name = v.host_name GROUP BY d.host_name ORDER BY d.host_name

recordings.name: q30-case-cte
recordings.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN severity_id >= 3 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS band, coalesce(message, 'none') AS msg FROM authentication) SELECT band, count(*) AS n FROM b GROUP BY band ORDER BY band
